steps: Create lead with assignedToEmployeeId="tm-emp-a1,tm-emp-a2" and query leads as Emp A1 and Emp A2
expected: Both employees can see and access the dual-assigned lead
actual: Schema / backend uses exact match (= ? OR = ?) so comma-separated IDs fail scoping: empA1SeesDual=false, empA2SeesDual=false. To assign 1 lead to 2 employees, either duplicate lead records or relational junction table (lead_assignments) is required.
evidence: assignedToEmployeeId is single string column in assigned_leads. Queried WHERE assignedToEmployeeId = user.id. String 'tm-emp-a1,tm-emp-a2' != 'tm-emp-a1'.

actual: Lead persisted in DB. Found ID: lead-a1-1789811933606, assignedToEmployeeId: tm-emp-a1-1789811931274
